analogy.rationale: The annotated targets are predominantly voltage-gated sodium and potassium channels, so drugs blocking these ion channels should share a similar membrane-excitability transcriptional signature; however, these cell lines are non-excitable and express these channels at low levels, so the overall response is expected to be weak.
